name: quai
description: Self-service infrastructure portal where every request ends up as a Git commit

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p server && tsc -p web
